title: Software Engineer
intro: MSc in Software Engineering with experience building scalable data platforms in AWS and Microsoft Azure, from data pipelines and database optimization to CI/CD and operations. I combine initiative with close collaboration, listen to customers and colleagues, ask the right questions, and deliver solutions that create value for the business.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Delivered Production Intelligence V4, a platform that processes 420M+ products a year. The update cut customers' loading times from 10s to 0.1s. Worked with cloud infrastructure in AWS and Microsoft Azure and served as the link between customers and internal stakeholders.

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Designed the data pipeline behind Production Intelligence V4 and evaluated storage formats that later reduced storage costs by 92%. Worked with PostgreSQL, optimizing SQL queries to reduce the load on the backend.

roles.title: Bachelor Thesis
roles.description: In close collaboration with a fellow student, developed a pipeline to generate synthetic images, which were used to train two AI models for object detection and 6DoF pose estimation of components in a bin. We coordinated continuously with Novo Nordisk, and the project was later used by researchers at SDU to improve their internal AI models.

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Part of a larger development team, responsible for collecting and analyzing data from distributed IoT devices. Used this data to build a web application where customers can monitor their products live, and worked closely with colleagues to ensure consistency across the system.

roles.title: MSc in Software Engineering
roles.description: Through robotics I was introduced to web development and haven't looked back since. During my master's I worked with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, CI/CD, cybersecurity, data security, and big data, mainly in project groups where planning, knowledge sharing, and shared responsibility were essential.

roles.title: BEng in Robotics
roles.description: Found my passion for software and mathematics through my studies. Programmed a UR5 robot arm to detect, grasp, and throw objects with collision-aware motion planning.
